name: Open Survey Builder (yuzushi-dev)
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted form and survey builder with no vendor-enforced form, response, or seat quota; includes visual editing, conditional logic, analytics and CSV exports.
watch_out: Requires self-managed Docker/Node.js and PostgreSQL, storage, backups and SMTP relay for email notifications; infrastructure and third-party mail costs are not included. Production security and maintenance are operator responsibilities.
